title: Oversized tight display
summary: Display type far beyond comfortable size (120–150px) with leading below 1, so words become shapes.
use_when: One statement per page that should be remembered.
avoid_when: More than once per page, or for anything longer than about 8 words.
recipe: .mega { font-size: clamp(64px, 10vw, 150px); line-height: .8–.9; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-wrap: balance; }
